name: io.github.GeiserX/duplicacy-mcp
title: Duplicacy MCP
description: MCP server for Duplicacy: backup health, status and Prometheus metrics from duplicacy-exporter

environmentVariables.name: DUPLICACY_EXPORTER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of duplicacy-exporter, for example http://localhost:9750

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: The MCP_AUTH_TOKEN value as a bearer token

environmentVariables.name: DUPLICACY_EXPORTER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of duplicacy-exporter as the container reaches it, for example http://duplicacy-exporter:9750

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token clients must send; the image refuses to start without one. At least 16 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the endpoint cross-origin
